newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ shares end slightly firmer on light volume.
newsitem.headline: NZ shares end slightly firmer on light volume.

text.p: * New Zealand share prices ended slightly firmer
* Late buying spurt pushes index higher

"Clearly there was an expectation that the U.S. market was going to have a difficult night on Friday and indeed it opened down 50 points, so for it to finish about square was taken by markets in this part of world with some relief," he said.
Media group INL was quoted higher but ended the day unchanged at NZ$7.00. Rattray said there was speculation that a deal to buy into Sky Network TV was imminent.
Fletcher Paper ended a little better, gaining two to end at NZ$2.73.
"They have underperformed their peers fairly dramatically over the last six months so there is probably a bit of catchup involved there," Rattray said.
Elsewhere, Ports of Auckland was strong at NZ$NZ$6.25, up 15 cents. Fisher and Paykel was also stronger, up seven at NZ$5.52.
